business_summary: Shanghai Jinjiang Shipping (Group) Co., Ltd. provides container transport, shipping, and shipping logistic services. It offers choice networks, individual services, vessel information, and container management services; specialized services; and e-commerce services. The company Shanghai Jinjiang Shipping (Group) Co., Ltd. was founded in 1983 and is based in Shanghai, China.
business_summary_ko: Shanghai Jinjiang Shipping (Group) Co., Ltd.는 컨테이너 운송, 운송 및 운송 물류 서비스를 제공합니다. 선택 네트워크, 개별 서비스, 선박 정보 및 컨테이너 관리 서비스를 제공합니다. 전문 서비스; 및 전자상거래 서비스. Shanghai Jinjiang Shipping (Group) Co., Ltd.는 1983년에 설립되었으며 중국 상하이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
